obs: Nashville Milk Co. v. Carnation Co.

"That codification establishes prima facie the laws of the United States, 1 U. S. C. 204 (a), and the countermanding considerations relied on by the Court do not seem sufficiently persuasive to us to rebut that construction."
Emray Realty Corp. v. Robert C. Weaver, as State Rent Administrator

“That Committee construed § 3 of the Robinson-Patman Act as part of the antitrust laws… That codification establishes ‘prima facie the laws of the United States,’ 1 U.S.C. § 204(a)… and the countermanding considerations relied on by the Court do not seem sufficiently persuasive to us to rebut that construction.”
